title: FRQ (c): average for a day
prompt:
Part (c): parallel arrays `days[i]` names the day of `temps[i]`. Implement `averageForDay(String[] days, double[] temps, String day)` returning the **average temperature for the given day**, or 0.0 when the day never appears.

Example: days {Mon, Tue, Mon}, temps {10.0, 20.0, 30.0}, day "Mon" → `20.0`.

tests.name: parallel average
tests.hint: Index loop (parallel arrays); count matches too — 0 matches returns 0.0 by spec, not division.
